rules.surface_note: Customer asks NEX for a wallpaper via chat. NEX matches request to one image from this manifest (or nearest match if exact isn't available). NEVER show the full list.
rules.no_nex_branding_allowed: Any image containing the NEX brand or name MUST be excluded. Reviewer audits each image before it becomes selectable.
rules.fallback_search: If no wallpaper in this manifest matches the request, NEX may offer the nearest match from this pool, or suggest the customer uploads their own.
rules.customer_uploads: Customer can attach their own image. NEX advises on required dimensions before upload.
rules.mutual_visibility: Per-conversation. When a customer sets a wallpaper, the OWNER sees THAT wallpaper when chatting with THAT customer only. Doesn't affect other conversations.
